title: workflow.schedule.fired payload
description: Payload emitted by the workflow_scheduler addon when a scheduled workflow's cron expression elapsed past its next-fire timestamp and the schedule_state row was advanced. The downstream run dispatcher subscribes to this event type to materialise a workflow_run for each fire. One event per (workflow_manifest_id, scheduled_for) pair; the schedule_state UpsertWorkflowScheduleState's CAS-style won-the-tick check guarantees no duplicate fires across multiple scheduler workers.

workflow_manifest_id.description: id of the workflow manifest whose schedule fired

scheduled_for.description: RFC3339 timestamp this fire was scheduled for (the cron tick that elapsed); not the wall-clock time the event was emitted

cron_expression.description: cron expression from the workflow's trigger.schedule.cron_expression — surfaced in the event for audit + replay so downstream consumers don't need to re-parse the manifest

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone the cron was evaluated in (defaults to UTC when absent)

default_inputs.description: trigger.schedule.default_inputs forwarded so the run dispatcher does not need to re-read the manifest
